newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A second group of Iraqi pilgrims left Saudi Arabia on Iraqi helicopters.
- Shell and Deminex oil companies signed a new oil exploration contract with Syria.
- Saudi Investment Bank posted a 44.2 million riyal net profit in the first quarter of 1997.
- Yemen's trade deficit increased to $200 million in 1996.
- King Fahd and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak discussed ways of boosting the Middle East peace process in Jeddah.
- Algeria is to participate in an international products exhibition in Bahrain in May.
- An Egyptian-Libyan committee discussed setting up four joint ventures with a capital of $900 million.
